slug: 2024-10-10 Liberia sets July 2025 deadline for SIM registration linked to national ID (LTA-NIR MoU)

facts.fact: The Liberia Telecommunications Authority and the National Identification Registry signed an MoU to link SIM cards to NIR-issued IDs through biometric registration, with a 10 July 2025 deadline after which unregistered SIMs would be deactivated and completion expected by end 2026.

slug: 2025-07-09 Liberia appoints steering committee for NBIS rollout by April 2026

facts.fact: A presidential steering committee was appointed on the National Biometric Identification System with a rollout deadline of 13 April 2026, the system being designed to support social welfare, banking and SIM registration.

note: Fact recorded under the ID system's planned support for other services; as_of is the published date, the document gives no other.

slug: 2025-03-12 Liberia says national ID system drives digital economy, facilitates service delivery

slug: 2025-04-30 Liberia makes biometric ID mandatory — Executive Order 147

facts.fact: Executive Order 147 makes the biometric national ID card the primary ID for public services and private transactions, requires all ministries, agencies and private institutions to enforce it, and has the NIR provide an online query portal and e-verification platform.
